headline: Kai, the fourth quarter opens with the ten-year fresh off its first 5.30 percent print since 2002 and Brent holding above $100 a barrel.
subline: Jobless claims and ISM manufacturing land this morning, Friday brings the September jobs report, and Micron just printed a $54 billion quarter.
asof: Pre-market · futures and prices as of 6:40 AM ET · every figure links to its source below

items.title: Ten-year yield breaks 5.30, highest since 2002
items.sentence: The benchmark yield pushed above 5.30 percent Wednesday for the first time in 24 years, per Invezz, and starts October near 5.29.

items.title: Futures tilt up with Brent back above $100
items.sentence: S&P futures trade near 7,732 with Nasdaq futures up 0.6 percent, Brent at $100.14 and gold at $4,194, per Yahoo Finance's live board.

items.title: September closes in the red for stocks
items.sentence: The S&P 500 slipped 0.3 percent Wednesday to 7,651.54 and the Dow fell 443.87 points as strong growth data pushed yields higher, per ABC News.

items.title: Micron beats and guides next quarter to $61.5 billion
items.sentence: Fiscal fourth-quarter revenue of $54.23 billion rose 379 percent on the AI-memory cycle, yet the stock barely moved on the print, per Yahoo Finance.

items.title: Bitcoin logs a fourth straight green September
items.sentence: Bitcoin gained 5.16 percent in September — its longest run of positive Septembers on record — and opens October near $83,700, per Yahoo Finance.

items.title: Iran says US ceasefire counterproposal has arrived
items.sentence: Iranian officials say Washington delivered a formal response to Tehran's seven-day ceasefire plan, with the two sides split over sequencing, per CBS News.

items.title: Hormuz oil flow claws back to 94 percent
items.sentence: Weekly crude and fuel exports reached about 21.8 million barrels a day against a 23.3 million prewar baseline, even after three ships were struck Tuesday, per CBS News.

items.title: New fiscal year opens with government funded
items.sentence: September's 370–48 House vote keeps agencies running through December 11, sparing October 1 a shutdown, per Breaking Defense.

items.title: French school protests turn violent
items.sentence: Demonstrations over classroom resources left dozens wounded and hundreds detained, per Euronews' morning bulletin.

items.title: Chinese hackers posed as US AI insiders
items.sentence: Proofpoint says a Beijing-aligned group impersonated a former White House tech official and an Anthropic employee to phish AI export-control experts, per CNN.

items.title: FTC opens probe into AI agent safety claims
items.sentence: The commission is investigating OpenAI, Anthropic and METR over agent safety claims and consumer protection, per The Neuron's daily digest.

items.title: Google ships Gemini 4 Argon with million-token context
items.sentence: The model lists at $2 per million input tokens and debuts at No. 1 on Text Arena, per The Neuron.

items.title: Nvidia authorizes a $150 billion buyback
items.sentence: Nvidia authorized $150 billion of share repurchases as AI infrastructure demand surges, per Tech Startups.

items.title: Amazon signs 20-year nuclear supply deal
items.sentence: Constellation shares rose after it agreed to supply Amazon with 190 megawatts from a Maryland facility for 20 years, per Yahoo Finance.
